what: BESKT PR 5B interview tool — the ROUTED browser walk
kind: the real application on its real routes, two authenticated assessors, against a local Postgres + PostgREST stack

steps.step: sign in and open the interview case
the module is present, and says what it does not produce
the same module in English
sign in straight to the BESKT route
the tool says what BESKT is and is not, before anything else
the method and its version are named
the same landing in English
the digests are behind a disclosure, not on the surface
all three candidate states are on screen, in words
a skipped answer is not dressed as a warning
the same snapshot in English
the submitted answers carry no control of any kind
opening the conversation support
an empty position names its blocker and offers no lock
both derived themes are present with their reason
each theme names the exact item key and method version
the same themes in English
the form has a field per kind of claim
each kind of claim goes in its own field
saving goes through the governed server function
an empty record is refused before it reaches the server
and accepted, and confirmed, once it says something
a correction without a reason is refused
with a reason it is accepted and becomes version 2
both versions are there, and which is current is said
a settled state is refused without a source
with a source it is recorded and appears in the history
moving to 'not verified' says what it does not mean
and the same in English
nothing of anyone else is on the page before the lock
the confirmation says what locking changes
cancelling changes nothing, confirming locks
state, revision and time are on screen; the lock is gone
the documentation itself is no longer editable
and the same, in English
the second assessor signs in and joins
the first assessor's record is nowhere on screen
and it never arrived in any response either
and the same in English
a record of their own, in their own words
locked, through the same described confirmation
and only NOW does the first assessor's record appear
the other assessor's own words, in full
and no figure is derived from the pair
and the same in English
a reopening without a reason is refused
with a reason it reopens, and the record survives
and it is locked again, so the panel can be revealed
the panel is opened, then revealed
common points and differences are both shown
a disagreement is refused without its divergent position
and recorded, word for word, once it carries one
and the assessors' own positions are untouched
and the same panel in English
